requirements operational workflows and enterprise system changes.

capabilities, governance structures, processes and UAE organizational design.

▪ Gather requirements on migration of Master Data Management (MDM) to Azure cloud. ▪ Led $50M Data migration from on-premises to cloud, Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) program Cloud Transformation. ▪ As a Business Data System Analyst created data quality standards, stewardship for“Golden Record” creation. ▪ BRD/ FSD creation for Online Industrial Platform (OIP) entity-asset models Dynamic-suite, industrial 3D TRASAR, 3DT, Komodo, LIMS data sources. ▪ Perform data mapping, source-to-target analysis, data quality assessments and integration impact analysis to ensure accurate, secure and

▪ Craft service operations workflow for Contact Center staff- SaaS integration, optimizing agent workflows and lifecycle management. ▪ Felicitate and created process maps and functional specifications for Salesforce Service Cloud implementations. ▪ Design and configured business rules including auto-assignment, escalation workflows, and triggers improving case management efficiency. ▪ Manag campaign workflows, audience segmentation, analytics to enable data-driven marketing strategies. ▪ Optimized agent journey lifecycle (case creation to closure), aligning system actions with business processes. ▪ Implement schema for Omni-Channel routing, integrate Salesforce with external systems data retrieval, load testing using Apache JMeter.

Work history:
Pune & Dubai
UK work permit: Dependent visa
Company Mastercard | July 2025 to April 2026| Lead Product Manager Technical (Fintech)| India
Project 1: Cross-Border B2B Payment Rails(Discovery & MVP)
Aim: Design new product where requirements for the SWIFT integration layer to build a market-testable framework for cross broader B2B.
Lead product discovery and MVP definition for a new payment platform alongside the Architecture, Engg & CX team.
Draft feature status state machines (Auth, Clearing & Settlement (DSM/SMS) SWIFT CUG, PACS.008/ CAMT and Circle for USDC/ coin settlement.
Focus XML modelling, data flow across Mastercard internal ecosystems including Salesforce CRM (lead) , MC-Connect(onboarding), SAM & GCMS.
Facilitate JAD sessions to define core system services, data models, participant management and BFF layers.
Project 2: Platform Modernization & Core Consolidation (PINS & PRO)
Aim: Consolidated two legacy architectures (PINS and PRO) into a scalable, competitive, API-first.
Led strategy, visioning, and design-thinking sessions to define future-state operating models and transformation roadmaps.
Define functional requirements and API design specs using Financial-grade API (FAPI) and OAuth 2.0.
Assess FR/NFR impacts to implement tokenization flows and infrastructure upgrades safely.
Refurbish front-end customer journeys and back-office operations for partner branch and BIN setups.
Manage requirements for transaction limits, remittances, real-time FX rates, payouts, corridor rules.
Engage for Tile creation, Service readiness, Gateway and SAA changes for onboarding, Branch configurations, O.I & TPPs setup.
Company EPAM| Dec 2024 to June 2025 |Assistant Manager cum Lead Business Analyst (IT services) | India
Project 1: Drilling Agent - RAG Enterprise Search Solutions
Aim: To empower field support teams with instant access to trusted enterprise knowledge through a secure AI-powered chatbot that enables
faster, context-aware information retrieval while establishing the foundation for scalable and governed GenAI adoption.
Authored SORs, SOPs, solution design documentation supporting scalable AI implementations for field support staff/ equipment.
Served as a DS BIA in the Data & Analytics Solutions Group, supporting Power & Utilities technology solutions.
Context validation, status reporting, VR diagrams creation on use cases for E&P upstream on Data ingestion, SharePoint, DMS integration.
Project 2: House of Carmen - Digital Creator Economy
Aim: Engineer a scalable Influencer Marketing ecosystem comprising a mobile application for influencer acquisition, onboarding, and campaign
engagement, and a web portal for campaign management, workflow automation, and operational oversight.
Delivered large-scale program, system architecture diagrams, software inventory lists, vendor contracts, & Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
Translated business vision into structured requirements, defining each journeys mapping touch points.
Facilitated workshops to define influencer onboarding flows, campaign management and monetization models aligned with market needs.
Defined user stories with clear acceptance criteria following INVEST principles and Definition of Ready to enable agile product development.
Company Synechron | Nov 2020 to Dec 2023 | Assistant Manager cum Specialist Business Analyst (IT services) | India & UAE
Project 1: Mobile Banking & Payments
Aim: Improve digital banking journeys and cross-border payment visibility.
Supported mobile banking enhancements focused on customer journeys, payment tracking and omnichannel banking experiences.
Defined requirements and validated API integrations with SWIFT gpi and SEPA for real-time payment status tracking.
Represented co-creation sessions, delivery squad PR’s, Change Advisory Board (CAB) approvals to production releases.
Project 2: Consumer Protection Regulatory (CPR) Program | UAE Banking | ~$980M
Aim: Enable regulatory compliance transformation by translating Central Bank policies into standardized mandates, operational workflows,
governance frameworks, and system-level banking changes thus strengthen customer protection across all channels - Nominated as one of the
initial consultants on the program, further armed BA/delivery team, scaling it to 15–20 members to execute Consumer Protection compliance
framework in stipulated time frame.
Built and operationalized CoEs to drive standardization, capability development, governance, and continuous improvement.
Acted as onshore proxy Program Manager, managing milestones, metrics, stakeholder alignment, and audit/compliance engagements.
Re-engineer business processes by translating Central Bank (CBUAE) consumer protection regulations into actionable business processes, system
requirements operational workflows and enterprise system changes.
Target Operating Model (TOM) Design & Implementation, leading end-to-end operating model transformation initiatives, defining future-state
capabilities, governance structures, processes and UAE organizational design.
Conducted visioning and co-creation workshops with senior BU leaders - cards, insurance, branches, internal auditing, BPM.
Alliance for test ware on channels IBMB, Branch Ops, ADMIN, SALAMA, Dubai First, Ijara services, Magnati, TMS, help centers, mail/ Archer, NTB.
Develop artifacts including RACI matrices, risk registers, SOPs and audit readiness documentation.
Partner with risk and compliance teams particularly to strengthen bank-wide compliance monitoring.
Reinforce implementation of consent management, vulnerable customer protections, and treating customers fairly (TCF) frameworks across digital
and operational channels.
a. Consumer protection -consent management, vulnerable customer handling, accessibility provisions.
b. Conduct risk-(cross-sell disclosures, employee training, performance alignment.
c.
Fair customer treatment frameworks -transparency standards, Customer Satisfaction Index.
Project 3: Digital Banking & Transformation
Aim: Modernize legacy banking applications and improve customer experience.
Experience supporting banking and financial services organizations through operating model, process, and business transformation initiatives.
Lead business analysis activities and managed team of global DEV aimed at migration of old UI screens to modern React-based upgrading.
Partner with customer/ users to streamline banking workflows and improve usability.
Support digital transformation initiatives focused on scalable and future-ready podiums.
Project 4: Card Services Digital Transformation
Aim: Bring card customer journeys from a third-party vendor host to HSBC-owned digital channels.
Engage on greenfield mobile application as part of Digital business banking DBB, bringing this travel card servicing capabilities in-house.
Draft scalable operating structures, roles, responsibilities, and governance frameworks aligned to strategic objectives.
Solutioning with (UK) SMEs, solution architects, and offshore engineering teams to define requirements and drive Agile delivery.
Act as Consultant and Scrum Master, managing sprint ceremonies, stakeholder communication and delivery coordination.
Company Takshashila | Nov 2019 to Aug 2020 | Management Consultant (IT Services) | UAE
Project: Finacle Core Consolidation program upgrade from v10.x to 11.x Finacle| UAE Banking
Govern delivery of a USD $8.5B Finacle 11x transformation portfolio, focused on operational excellence, program governance & IT coordination.
Direct end-to-end project lifecycle- performing gap assessment, walkthroughs, training and go-live to PGL execution.
Manage schedules, dependencies, risks, obligations and operational governance.
Lead regional and cross-functional teams, facilitating business process design (BPD), BPM, automation (RPA) and non-STP process standardization.
Partner/Report the Head of Program Group and Chief Officer at Emirates Islamic, the Head of Operations Governance at Emirates NBD.
Provide continues monitoring & reporting on transformation progress, strategic risks, delivery performance.
Establish frameworks for client management, approval hierarchies, milestone sign-offs and delivery controls.
Partner with Audit, Trade Finance, Treasury, Fund Transfer, upstream channels (ATM, CDM, IVR, Digital Portals)
, UAM, Data Migration, Process
Documentation, Report Rationalization and Business Process Design.
Govern a multi-vendor delivery ecosystem comprising external QA partners (30+ resources), internal teams, implementation partners while
safeguarding alignment with Islamic Banking principles, Sharia-compliant GCC localization and linguistic initiatives.
Administer UAE-specific banking integrations with UAEFTS, Emirates ID (EIDA), Trade Finance and localization laws.
Chaire executive reviewing delivery milestones, program health, risks, escalations, KPI performance and issue resolution.
Company Accenture |Feb 2017 to Oct 2019 | Lead Analyst (IT Services)
Project 1: Enterprise Data Modernization EnVision – Microsoft Avanade
Aim: Industrial Legacy applications o Cloud migration
Gather requirements on migration of Master Data Management (MDM) to Azure cloud.
Led $50M Data migration from on-premises to cloud, Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) program Cloud Transformation.
As a Business Data System Analyst created data quality standards, stewardship for“Golden Record” creation.
BRD/ FSD creation for Online Industrial Platform (OIP) entity-asset models Dynamic-suite, industrial 3D TRASAR, 3DT, Komodo, LIMS data sources.
Perform data mapping, source-to-target analysis, data quality assessments and integration impact analysis to ensure accurate, secure and
compliant migration of master data, data integrity across Azure Blob and Teradata.
Draft data wrangling rules (normalization, transformation, contextualization) to support analytics and reporting use cases.
Enable business insights through Power BI dashboards and OLTP/OLAP integration for DevOps environments use Azure DevOps CI/CD.
Support testing, data validation, reconciliation, defect management, and post-migration verification, data integrity.
Project 2: Service Assurance Integration Layer SAIL– CRM Contact Centre
Aim: Designing API for salesforce contact center portal
Craft service operations workflow for Contact Center staff- SaaS integration, optimizing agent workflows and lifecycle management.
Felicitate and created process maps and functional specifications for Salesforce Service Cloud implementations.
Design and configured business rules including auto-assignment, escalation workflows, and triggers improving case management efficiency.
Manag campaign workflows, audience segmentation, analytics to enable data-driven marketing strategies.
Optimized agent journey lifecycle (case creation to closure), aligning system actions with business processes.
Implement schema for Omni-Channel routing, integrate Salesforce with external systems data retrieval, load testing using Apache JMeter.
Project 3: Capital Change Program | Bank of Ireland – LIBOR Transition Program
Aim: Define business change logic for the migration of mortgage products from LIBOR to ECB benchmark interest rates.
Conduct impact analysis across lending, customer account management, interest rate calculation and credit decision processes.
Plan data-journey & storage requirements on account information, credit decisions, registers investment agents RIA.
Communicate with business stakeholders, ETL development teams to define data flows, system functional requirements.
Perform data quality analysis using Informatica to identify and resolve source data anomalies.
Company Avalara| Oct 2015 to Dec 2016 | Senior Business Release Manager (Startup)
Project: Taxation Accounting Adapter product
As product engineer for the Taxation Connector (AvaTax Adapter) supporting B2B accounting integrations, gathered processing rules for indirect
taxes, invoice processing and compliance across ERP, CRM, and eCommerce, European EU geography.
Define custom data flows covering Opportunity-to-Quote-to-Cash processes between ERP/ POS to calculate tax invoicing.
Team up with product, engineering and integration teams to configure and support pre-built connectors, ensuring seamless integration with
Microsoft Dynamics 365, Salesforce, QuickBooks, Sage 300 other ERP systems.
Support release management, version & documentation, production tickets, marketing and Sales team, Content management SME, deployment
activities including SaaS/on-prem integrations, hotfix validation.
Analyze on workflow, SOAP logs, XML/JSON data, debugging integration issues and UAT to ensure accurate jurisdictional and invoice compliance.
Company Fiserv| Mar 2014 to Sep 2015 | Senior Engineer (Product based)
Project 1: Business Analyst | Digital Banking Transformation (Westpac OTP Project)
Aim: With help from Fiserv, Westpac deployed Digital Banking Platform (DBP) Omnichannel category, modern Live digital.
Requirements Design: Worked with senior leaders to map business use cases for deploying the Fiserv Corillian mobile and online banking.
Testing & Validation: Created complete validation scenarios and test plans in HP ALM / Quality Center to guarantee a smooth rollout.
Data Management & Analysis: Used SQL to extract and manage test data sets to cover all legacy system dependencies and account structures.
Incident Resolution & War Rooms: Joined high-pressure migration war rooms to help troubleshoot and quickly resolve critical rollout blockers.
MVP Launch: Successfully delivered the iOS and Android MVP features including user registration, ERP touch points, multi-account fund transfers,
notifications, business banking journeys, Centralized preference and service management, such as payers / payees, roles and entitlements,
Integrated alerting and notifications.
Project 2: Product Business Analyst | FCRM Suite (Financial Crime Risk Management)
Aim: Compiling software demand by passing altered data, bridging the gap between mainframe infrastructure and regulatory requirements
Modify core FCRM system rules and alert definitions to keep the product aligned with regulations of FinCEN, BSA, and FATF.
Product Testing & Verification: created simulated altered transaction data through the FCRM engine to verify that newly customized alert triggers
and risk scoring models CDD EDD, STR, CTR/SAR reporting and case management workflows trigger.
Map core product scenarios for KYC/CDD onboarding, sanctions screening, blacklist handling, and automated SAR/CTR reporting.
Simulate altered transaction to verify that newly customized alert definition and risk scoring models worked flawlessly.
Mainframe Integration: Partnered with mainframe developers to validate data mapping for list matching, PEP and false-positive reduction.
Company Cognizant Technology Services | Feb 2011 to Feb 2014 | Programmer Analyst (IT Services)
Project 1: Wells Fargo Cash Equities Trading Software - Investment Banking and Capital Market
Ensure appropriate documentation of requirements is captured and recorded, supported validation of Order Management System (OMS).
Construct Terminal messages (FIX protocol) for order placement, establish connectivity and validity parameters.
Ensure trade lifecycle (capture → settlement → reconciliation) & post-trade (Custodian corporate actions, Asset services, Tax services).
Develop experience of full involvement in project life cycles within Investment Banking, Capital Markets & cash equities trading.
Create BRD for Pinpoint, Opera (front office and booking system) MOAP, EMEA trade business flows for MIFID 2 and Brexit.
Validate the trade life cycle (front Office, middle office, and back office) and order journey in FIX 4.2 protocol, test exchange connectivity, Smart
Order Routing, Algorithmic Trading / High Frequency Trading, High Volume Ticker Data Handling and Post Trade Settlements handling.
Project 2: JPMC Identity & Access Management (IAM) Identity Toolkit - Asset Management
Gather on-call requirements, sample files for J.P. Morgan Security Services IMSD approval process.
Review feed files for P1, P2, Auto File Converter (AFC) on client certifications, termination, and transfer processes.
